subject: Clarifying retention tiers & SIG carveouts for MAP close
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Boyd <clara.boyd@praxispay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying retention tiers & SIG carveouts for MAP close

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, we want to make sure the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) captures the exact compliance gates so you can hit your security review and procurement timelines. Two asks from my side to make the technical review quicker: 

1) A short table with the retention windows that matter to you (transaction logs vs PII-derived indexes vs ephemeral caches). I attached a template (data_retention_table.xlsx).
2) Any SIG questions you consider "deal blockers" (e.g., encryption at rest for backup snapshots, shared responsibility boundaries). If you mark those, we can add carveouts to prioritize evidence.

Proposed schedule:
- This week: you flag blockers + fill retention sheet
- Next Tue: we hand over SOC 2 summary + SIG evidence pack
- Example week after: DPA redline and DocuSign execution

Quick note on retention tiers from our side — we separate short-term caches (default 7 days), operational logs (30–90 days configurable by customer), and long-term archival for compliance (customer-controlled; can be 1–7 years depending on plan). We can lock the values for PraxisPay in the MAP as part of the service-level appendix.

Attaching a brief SOC 2 snapshot (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) for your security team. If you want a deeper intake call with our compliance engineer, Lauren can join.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: data_retention_table.xlsx (template), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary)

From: Clara Boyd <clara.boyd@praxispay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PraxisPay Legal <legal@praxispay.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying retention tiers & SIG carveouts for MAP close

Hi Mateo —

Thanks, that helps. I filled the retention tab in your template and attached a short note with the three SIG items our InfoSec team flagged as gating:
- Snapshot backups must use customer-managed KMS keys (we'd need an explanation of KMS integration and rotation cadence)
- Data residency for archival snapshots (we need a US-only option, no multi-region replication)
- Audit log retention: 13 months for user access events for product compliance

On the DPA side, our legal team prefers redlining before DocuSign. I'll loop in our counsel but wanted to get the MAP-level commitments confirmed first.

I'll attach the completed retention table and our SIG checklist in a follow-up (sending via separate email due to size). Can we plan a 30-minute intake with your compliance engineer Wednesday 10am PT?

—Clara
Clara Boyd
Head of Product Security, PraxisPay
clara.boyd@praxispay.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Boyd <clara.boyd@praxispay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying retention tiers & SIG carveouts for MAP close

Clara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I reviewed the filled retention table — couple of clarifications inline below and a suggested MAP entry.

Inline notes: 
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (bring-your-own-key). Backups and long-term archives can be encrypted with customer keys; rotation is supported and documented (we rotate keys on customer request; key material never leaves the HSM). I'll have Grace add the KMS integration diagram to the evidence pack.
- Data residency: we can lock archival buckets to a single cloud region (us-west-2) for the PraxisPay instance. That will be captured as a MAP constraint and enforced by the private deployment config.
- Audit log retention: we can extend default retention to 13 months for your account; cost delta is tiny and we'll enumerate it in the pricing appendix.

Suggested MAP entry (short form):
"Security Acceptance Criteria — PraxisPay"
- SOC 2 Type II summary provided to InfoSec by 2028-05-07
- SIG/CAIQ response subset (priority items flagged by PraxisPay) delivered 2028-05-09
- KMS BYOK integration documentation delivered 2028-05-09; implementation during staging: 2028-05-16
- DPA redline exchange 2028-05-10; execution target 2028-05-17
- Retention windows locked in MAP: caches 7d, operational logs 90d, audit logs 13 months, long-term archive 7 years (customer-controlled)

If this looks right, we'll push the timeline into the shared MAP doc and trigger the evidence handoff. Also attaching SIG-Assessment-Request.pdf for your team to confirm which SIG questions are highest priority.

I booked the intake call for Wed 10am PT with our compliance engineer (Grace). Invite to follow.

—Mateo

Attachments: SIG-Assessment-Request.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Boyd <clara.boyd@praxispay.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PraxisPay Legal <legal@praxispay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying retention tiers & SIG carveouts for MAP close

Clara —

Quick legal note on the DPA process: to streamline, we prefer PraxisPay to provide redlines in DocuSign or as a single consolidated mark-up in Google Docs. Once both sides agree, we'll prepare a clean DPA for signature. For timing, if PraxisPay sends redlines by Friday 05/10 we can push an executed DPA by 05/17.

Also: if PraxisPay requires stricter contractual language around backup key custody, please flag the exact clause so we can propose language.

I'll watch for the SIG priorities from your team after the intake call.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Clara Boyd <clara.boyd@praxispay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, PraxisPay Legal <legal@praxispay.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying retention tiers & SIG carveouts for MAP close

Thanks all — call went well. PraxisPay InfoSec prioritized three SIG items (we returned the annotated SIG pdf during the call). We'll send formal DPA redlines by EOD Monday. Agreed on the MAP milestones you proposed — locking SOC 2 summary and the SIG subset by 05/09.

Two quick confirmations for the MAP: 
- PraxisPay accepts the 13-month audit log retention and the single-region archival as MAP commitments.
- We want an explicit rollback plan in the MAP if a migration is needed — can your operations team propose a one-page rollback runbook?

I'll upload the annotated SIG responses and DPA redlines to the HubSpot deal record (link below) and send the DocuSign request once we have a final DPA.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4832

—Clara

Attachments: annotated_SIG_priorities.pdf (uploaded to deal), DPA_redlines_expected_Mon_05_06.docx
